What We Create

Custom Human Statues

One focused service: turning photographs of real people into personalised 3D statues.

👤

Photo to 3D Statue

Send clear photographs of the person. We create a personalised 3D model based on the face, clothing, pose and other visible details.

  • Single-person statues
  • Couple & family statues
  • Full-body, half-body & bust styles
  • Custom pose and clothing details
  • 3D design preview before printing
Message us for a quote
🖨️

3D Printing & Finishing

After the design is approved, we prepare the model for printing, produce the statue using FDM 3D printing, and finish the physical piece.

  • Creality Ender 3 FDM printing
  • Model preparation and slicing
  • Surface preparation
  • Acrylic painting and protective varnish
  • Careful packing and courier delivery
Custom size & finish
Simple Process

From Photo to Statue

A simple process built around your photos, design approval and final statue.

01

Send Photos

Send clear front, side and full-body photographs through WhatsApp. Useful reference photos help with the 3D model.

02

3D Model

We create and refine the digital human statue, including the pose, clothing and visible details.

03

Approve & Pay

You review the 3D design. After approval, we confirm the order and start production.

04

Print & Deliver

The statue is printed, finished, packed carefully and sent to your delivery address by courier.

Roy3D Statue
Custom Human 3D Statue Service | Bangalore

Roy3D Statue is focused on creating personalised human statues from customer photographs. The goal is simple: turn an important person, memory or moment into a physical 3D statue.

Each order can be handled from digital modelling through print preparation, FDM 3D printing and finishing. The customer can review the digital design before production so the final print starts from an agreed model.

👤 Human Statue Modelling 📷 Photo to 3D 🖨️ FDM Printing 🎨 Finishing & Painting
